name: Mailtrap
description: Mailtrap email platform: send transactional, bulk and batch emails, test them in Email Sandbox (messages, spam and HTML reports), manage sending domains, suppressions, templates, Email Marketing contacts, lists and campaigns, and read sending stats and email logs.
instructions:
## Mailtrap
This connector uses the **Mailtrap API** for one Mailtrap account: sending transactional and bulk email (Email API), testing email in **Email Sandbox**, sending domains, suppressions, sending stats and email logs, email templates, and **Email Marketing** contacts, lists and campaigns. Mailtrap serves these areas from different hosts and the connector picks the right one per tool: `https://mailtrap.io` for management and reports, `https://send.api.mailtrap.io` for transactional sending, `https://bulk.api.mailtrap.io` for the Bulk stream and `https://sandbox.api.mailtrap.io` for test sends into a sandbox.

**Setup (3 minutes)**
1. In Mailtrap open **Settings**, **API Tokens** (https://mailtrap.io/api-tokens) and create a token. Give it access to the sending domains (for sending, stats, logs and suppressions), the sandboxes or projects (for Email Sandbox) and, if you use it, Email Marketing. Admin access is needed to change suppressions.
2. Paste it into `MAILTRAP_API_TOKEN`. It is sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` and does not expire until you reset it.
3. Run `mailtrap_list_accounts` to check the token. A token belongs to one account and every call works on that account, so no account id is needed.
4. Live sending needs a verified sending domain (`mailtrap_list_sending_domains`); Email Sandbox works without one.

**Sending email**
- `mailtrap_send_email` sends one transactional email, `mailtrap_send_batch_emails` up to 500 different ones in one call. Marketing and other bulk mail belongs on the Bulk stream: `mailtrap_send_bulk_email` and `mailtrap_send_bulk_batch_emails`.
- Content is `text`, `html` or both, or a stored template: pass `template_uuid` (the `uuid` from `mailtrap_list_templates`, not the numeric id) with `template_variables`, and leave `subject`, `text`, `html` and `category` out.
- `from_email` must be on a verified sending domain. `to`, `cc` and `bcc` are lists of `{"email", "name"}`. Attachments are Base64 in `content`.
- **Sending is real.** Before any send, batch, bulk send or campaign start, show the user the recipients, sender, subject and content and wait for a clear yes. To try a message out first, send it with `mailtrap_send_sandbox_email` and look at it in the sandbox.
- A send answers `message_ids`, one per recipient; follow them with `mailtrap_get_email_log`. Batch calls answer 200 even when single messages fail: check `success` and `errors` of each entry in `responses`.

**Email Sandbox (testing)**
- Find sandboxes with `mailtrap_list_sandboxes` or by project with `mailtrap_list_sandbox_projects`; `mailtrap_get_sandbox` shows one, `mailtrap_create_sandbox` adds one to a project.
- Send test mail with `mailtrap_send_sandbox_email`: it is caught in the sandbox and never delivered.
- Inspect: `mailtrap_list_sandbox_messages`, `mailtrap_get_sandbox_message`, `mailtrap_get_sandbox_message_body` (txt, html, htmlsource or raw), `mailtrap_get_sandbox_message_headers`, `mailtrap_list_sandbox_attachments`, `mailtrap_get_sandbox_spam_report` (SpamAssassin score) and `mailtrap_get_sandbox_html_analysis` (email client support).
- `mailtrap_clean_sandbox` deletes every message in a sandbox; confirm first.

**Domains and deliverability**
- `mailtrap_list_sending_domains`, `mailtrap_get_sending_domain` (DNS records and their verification), `mailtrap_create_sending_domain`, `mailtrap_send_domain_setup_instructions` (emails the DNS steps to whoever manages DNS).
- Suppressed addresses get no mail: `mailtrap_list_suppressions`, `mailtrap_create_suppression`, `mailtrap_delete_suppression` (only when the recipient asked for it or the bounce is resolved).
- What happened to an email: `mailtrap_list_email_logs` (filter by recipient, status, events, category, sent time), then `mailtrap_get_email_log` for its delivery, open, click and bounce events.
- Totals: `mailtrap_get_sending_stats` for a date range, `mailtrap_get_sending_stats_grouped` split by domain, category, mailbox provider or day. Usage against the plan: `mailtrap_get_billing_usage`.

**Templates**: `mailtrap_list_templates`, `mailtrap_get_template`, `mailtrap_create_template`, `mailtrap_update_template`. Variables use Handlebars, e.g. `{{user_name}}`.

**Email Marketing**
- Contacts: `mailtrap_list_contacts`, `mailtrap_get_contact` and `mailtrap_update_contact` (by id or email), `mailtrap_create_contact`, `mailtrap_delete_contact`, custom events with `mailtrap_create_contact_event`. Many contacts at once: `mailtrap_import_contacts`, then `mailtrap_get_contact_import` until it is finished.
- Lists and fields: `mailtrap_list_contact_lists`, `mailtrap_create_contact_list`, `mailtrap_list_contact_fields` (the merge tags used as keys in `fields`).
- Campaigns: `mailtrap_list_campaigns`, `mailtrap_get_campaign`, `mailtrap_get_campaign_stats`. Build one with `mailtrap_create_campaign` (always a draft) and `mailtrap_update_campaign`, then `mailtrap_schedule_campaign` or `mailtrap_start_campaign`; `mailtrap_cancel_campaign` returns a scheduled campaign to draft. Scheduling and starting email the whole audience: confirm first.
- Add only contacts who agreed to receive email. To stop mailing someone, unsubscribe them (`unsubscribed: true`) rather than deleting them.

**Reading the answers**: ids of domains, sandboxes, messages, templates, lists and campaigns are integers; contacts, suppressions and email log messages use UUIDs. Times are ISO 8601 in UTC. Stats rates are fractions (0.25 = 25%); stats dates are `YYYY-MM-DD`. Sandbox and template lists leave out SMTP credentials and bodies.

**Paging**
- Contacts: pass `pagination.next_token` as `token`; stop when it is null. Campaigns: `token` is a page number taken from `pagination.next_token`.
- Email logs: pass `next_page_cursor` as `search_after`. Suppressions: pass the `id` of the last item as `last_id` (1000 per page). Sandbox messages: 30 per page, use `page` or the last message id as `last_id`.

**Limits**: 150 requests per 10 seconds per token; Contacts 200 per minute, Stats and Suppressions 10 per minute, listing email logs 60 per minute per account. A send takes up to 1000 recipients, a batch up to 500 messages and 50 MB.

**Errors**: 401 `Incorrect API token` (wrong token, or no access to that domain or sandbox), 403 missing permission, 404 unknown id, 422 invalid input with the reason in `errors` (e.g. sender not on a verified domain, campaign not in draft), 429 rate limit.

**Switched off at install**: `mailtrap_delete_suppression`, `mailtrap_clean_sandbox` and `mailtrap_delete_contact`; they cannot be undone, so an admin switches them on when the team needs them.
prerequisites: A Mailtrap account and an API token from Settings, API Tokens with access to the domains, sandboxes and features you want to use.

MAILTRAP_API_TOKEN.label: API token
MAILTRAP_API_TOKEN.help: mailtrap.io, Settings, API Tokens: create a token and give it access to the sending domains, sandboxes and Email Marketing as needed. It belongs to one account.
MAILTRAP_API_TOKEN.patternMessage: Paste only the token, without spaces, quotes or a Bearer prefix.

verifyHints.401: Mailtrap refused the API token ("Incorrect API token"). Copy it again from Settings, API Tokens; paste the token itself.
verifyHints.403: The token has no permission for this domain, sandbox or feature. Edit its permissions under Settings, API Tokens.
verifyHints.429: Mailtrap rate limit reached (150 requests per 10 seconds per token; stats and suppressions 10 per minute). Wait and try again.

tools.name: mailtrap_list_accounts
tools.description: Mailtrap accounts the API token can reach, with id, name and access_levels (1000 owner, 100 admin, 10 viewer). Needs no parameters; use it to check the token.

tools.name: mailtrap_get_billing_usage
tools.description: Usage of the current billing cycle: plan names and sent or stored message counts against their limits for Email Sending, Email Sandbox and Email Marketing.

tools.name: mailtrap_send_email
tools.description: Send one transactional email through the Email API (send.api.mailtrap.io): to up to 1000 recipients, with text and/or HTML, or from a stored template with variables. Real email: confirm recipients, subject and content with the user first. Returns message_ids, one per recipient.

from_email.description: Sender address. For live sending it must be on a verified sending domain of the account (see mailtrap_list_sending_domains).

cc.description: Cc recipients, same shape as to.

bcc.description: Bcc recipients, same shape as to.

subject.description: Subject line. Leave out when sending with template_uuid.

text.description: Plain-text body. text, html or both are required unless template_uuid is given.

category.description: Category for statistics and logs, e.g. "Password reset" (max 255 characters). Not allowed together with template_uuid.

template_uuid.description: UUID of a Mailtrap email template (mailtrap_list_templates, field uuid). Subject and bodies then come from the template; leave subject, text, html and category out.

template_variables.description: Values for the template variables, e.g. {"user_name": "Jane", "reset_link": "https://..."}.

attachments.description: Attachments: [{"filename": "invoice.pdf", "content": "<Base64>", "type": "application/pdf", "disposition": "attachment"}]. Use disposition "inline" with content_id to embed an image referenced as cid:<content_id>.

headers.description: Extra MIME headers as string pairs, e.g. {"X-Message-Source": "app"}.

custom_variables.description: Your own string values stored with the message and sent back in webhooks and email logs, e.g. {"order_id": "123"}.

tools.name: mailtrap_send_batch_emails
tools.description: Send up to 500 different transactional emails in one call (send.api.mailtrap.io/api/batch): shared fields in base, one entry per message in requests. Real email: confirm first. Answers 200 even when single messages fail; check success and errors of every entry in responses.

base.description: Fields shared by every message: from, reply_to, subject, text, html, category, template_uuid, template_variables, attachments, headers, custom_variables. Example: {"from": {"email": "news@example.com", "name": "Example"}, "template_uuid": "..."}.

requests.description: The messages, at most 500 (50 MB in total). Each takes the same fields as base plus to, cc and bcc; a field set here overrides base. Example: [{"to": [{"email": "jane@example.com"}], "template_variables": {"name": "Jane"}}].

tools.name: mailtrap_send_bulk_email
tools.description: Send one marketing or bulk email through the Bulk stream (bulk.api.mailtrap.io), which keeps promotional traffic apart from transactional mail. Same fields as mailtrap_send_email. Real email: confirm first.

from_email.description: Sender address. For live sending it must be on a verified sending domain of the account (see mailtrap_list_sending_domains).

cc.description: Cc recipients, same shape as to.

bcc.description: Bcc recipients, same shape as to.

subject.description: Subject line. Leave out when sending with template_uuid.

text.description: Plain-text body. text, html or both are required unless template_uuid is given.

category.description: Category for statistics and logs, e.g. "Password reset" (max 255 characters). Not allowed together with template_uuid.

template_uuid.description: UUID of a Mailtrap email template (mailtrap_list_templates, field uuid). Subject and bodies then come from the template; leave subject, text, html and category out.

template_variables.description: Values for the template variables, e.g. {"user_name": "Jane", "reset_link": "https://..."}.

attachments.description: Attachments: [{"filename": "invoice.pdf", "content": "<Base64>", "type": "application/pdf", "disposition": "attachment"}]. Use disposition "inline" with content_id to embed an image referenced as cid:<content_id>.

headers.description: Extra MIME headers as string pairs, e.g. {"X-Message-Source": "app"}.

custom_variables.description: Your own string values stored with the message and sent back in webhooks and email logs, e.g. {"order_id": "123"}.

tools.name: mailtrap_send_bulk_batch_emails
tools.description: Send up to 500 different bulk (marketing) emails in one call through the Bulk stream (bulk.api.mailtrap.io/api/batch). Same shape as mailtrap_send_batch_emails. Real email: confirm first; check every entry in responses.

base.description: Fields shared by every message: from, reply_to, subject, text, html, category, template_uuid, template_variables, attachments, headers, custom_variables. Example: {"from": {"email": "news@example.com", "name": "Example"}, "template_uuid": "..."}.

requests.description: The messages, at most 500 (50 MB in total). Each takes the same fields as base plus to, cc and bcc; a field set here overrides base. Example: [{"to": [{"email": "jane@example.com"}], "template_variables": {"name": "Jane"}}].

tools.name: mailtrap_list_sending_domains
tools.description: Sending domains of the account with their id, DNS verification and compliance status and tracking settings. DNS records are left out; mailtrap_get_sending_domain has them.

tools.name: mailtrap_get_sending_domain
tools.description: One sending domain with the DNS records to publish (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, return path) and whether each is verified, plus compliance status and tracking and alert settings.

tools.name: mailtrap_create_sending_domain
tools.description: Add a sending domain. Mailtrap answers with the DNS records to publish; sending works once they are verified and the compliance check passed.

domain_name.description: The domain or subdomain to send from, e.g. mail.example.com.

tools.name: mailtrap_send_domain_setup_instructions
tools.description: Email the DNS setup instructions of a sending domain to someone, e.g. the person who manages DNS.

tools.name: mailtrap_list_suppressions
tools.description: Addresses Mailtrap no longer sends to (hard bounce, unsubscription, spam complaint, manual import), up to 1000 per call, with the message that caused it. Filter by exact email or creation time.

start_time.description: Created at or after, ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z.

last_id.description: Id (UUID) of the last suppression of the previous page, for the next page.

tools.name: mailtrap_create_suppression
tools.description: Stop sending to an address on one domain and stream. Needs admin access.

type.description: Reason; manual import when left out.

tools.name: mailtrap_delete_suppression
tools.description: Remove a suppression so the address receives email again. Only do this when the recipient asked for it or the bounce is resolved. Needs admin access.

tools.name: mailtrap_get_sending_stats
tools.description: Sending totals for a date range: delivery, bounce, open, click and spam counts and rates, optionally limited to domains, streams, categories or mailbox providers.

email_service_providers.description: Only these recipient mailbox providers, e.g. ["Google", "Microsoft"].

tools.name: mailtrap_get_sending_stats_grouped
tools.description: The same sending stats split by sending domain, category, recipient mailbox provider or day.

email_service_providers.description: Only these recipient mailbox providers, e.g. ["Google", "Microsoft"].

tools.name: mailtrap_list_email_logs
tools.description: Sent messages of the account, newest first, with status, recipient, subject, category, opens and clicks. Filter by sent time and by filters; page with next_page_cursor.

sent_after.description: Sent at or after, ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z.

filters.description: Filters keyed by field, each {"operator": ..., "value": ...}: to, from, subject (ci_equal, ci_not_equal, ci_contain, ci_not_contain), status (equal, not_equal: delivered, not_delivered, enqueued, opted_out), events (include_event, not_include_event: delivery, open, click, bounce, spam, unsubscribe, soft_bounce, reject, suspension), category, domain_id, sending_stream (equal, not_equal). Example: {"to": {"operator": "ci_equal", "value": "jane@example.com"}, "status": {"operator": "equal", "value": "not_delivered"}}. Use one value per filter.

tools.name: mailtrap_get_email_log
tools.description: One sent message with its delivery events (delivery, open, click, bounce with the provider response), custom variables, template and a link to the raw message.

message_id.description: Message id (UUID) from mailtrap_list_email_logs or from a send result.

tools.name: mailtrap_list_sandbox_projects
tools.description: Email Sandbox projects with the sandboxes (test inboxes) in each.

tools.name: mailtrap_list_sandboxes
tools.description: All sandboxes (test inboxes) with id, name, project, message and unread counts and the sandbox email address. SMTP credentials are left out.

tools.name: mailtrap_get_sandbox
tools.description: One sandbox: name, project, message counts, size limits, SMTP host and ports and its email address. SMTP credentials are left out.

tools.name: mailtrap_list_sandbox_messages
tools.description: Messages caught in a sandbox, newest first, 30 per page: id, subject, sender, recipient, sent time, size and read state (SMTP details and blacklist reports are left out). Search by subject or recipient.

last_id.description: Returns the page of messages older than this message id.

tools.name: mailtrap_get_sandbox_message
tools.description: One sandbox message: sender, recipient, subject, size, SMTP details and blacklist report summary.

tools.name: mailtrap_get_sandbox_message_body
tools.description: The body of a sandbox message: txt (plain text), html (sanitized for preview), htmlsource (the HTML as sent) or raw (the whole MIME message).

tools.name: mailtrap_get_sandbox_message_headers
tools.description: The mail headers of a sandbox message (From, To, Subject, Message-ID, List-Unsubscribe, ...).

tools.name: mailtrap_get_sandbox_spam_report
tools.description: SpamAssassin report of a sandbox message: total score, threshold and the rules that matched.

tools.name: mailtrap_get_sandbox_html_analysis
tools.description: HTML check of a sandbox message: which elements and CSS properties are unsupported by which email clients, with an overall support score.

tools.name: mailtrap_list_sandbox_attachments
tools.description: Attachments of a sandbox message with filename, content type, size and download path.

attachment_type.description: Only this disposition, e.g. inline or attachment.

tools.name: mailtrap_send_sandbox_email
tools.description: Send a test email into a sandbox (sandbox.api.mailtrap.io): it is caught there and never reaches the recipients, so it is safe for trying templates and content. Same fields as mailtrap_send_email.

from_email.description: Sender address; any address works in a sandbox.

cc.description: Cc recipients, same shape as to.

bcc.description: Bcc recipients, same shape as to.

subject.description: Subject line. Leave out when sending with template_uuid.

text.description: Plain-text body. text, html or both are required unless template_uuid is given.

category.description: Category for statistics and logs, e.g. "Password reset" (max 255 characters). Not allowed together with template_uuid.

template_uuid.description: UUID of a Mailtrap email template (mailtrap_list_templates, field uuid). Subject and bodies then come from the template; leave subject, text, html and category out.

template_variables.description: Values for the template variables, e.g. {"user_name": "Jane", "reset_link": "https://..."}.

attachments.description: Attachments: [{"filename": "invoice.pdf", "content": "<Base64>", "type": "application/pdf", "disposition": "attachment"}]. Use disposition "inline" with content_id to embed an image referenced as cid:<content_id>.

headers.description: Extra MIME headers as string pairs, e.g. {"X-Message-Source": "app"}.

custom_variables.description: Your own string values stored with the message and sent back in webhooks and email logs, e.g. {"order_id": "123"}.

tools.name: mailtrap_create_sandbox
tools.description: Create a sandbox (test inbox) in a project; the answer carries its id and email address, SMTP credentials left out.

tools.name: mailtrap_clean_sandbox
tools.description: Delete every message in a sandbox. Cannot be undone; confirm with the user first.

tools.name: mailtrap_list_contacts
tools.description: Email Marketing contacts, 25 per page by default (at most 50), with id, email, status, list ids and fields. Filter by list, status or part of the email; page with pagination.next_token.

tools.name: mailtrap_get_contact
tools.description: One contact by id or email: status, lists, fields and timestamps.

contact_identifier.description: The contact id (UUID) or the contact's email address, as returned by mailtrap_list_contacts.

tools.name: mailtrap_create_contact
tools.description: Add a contact, optionally with fields (by merge tag) and lists. Add only people who agreed to receive email.

fields.description: Field values keyed by merge tag (mailtrap_list_contact_fields), e.g. {"first_name": "Jane", "company": "Acme"}.

list_ids.description: Lists to add the contact to.

tools.name: mailtrap_update_contact
tools.description: Change a contact: email, fields, list membership or subscription status. Answers whether it was updated or created.

contact_identifier.description: The contact id (UUID) or the contact's email address, as returned by mailtrap_list_contacts.

email.description: The contact's email address; Mailtrap requires it on every update, so pass the current one when it does not change.

fields.description: Field values to set, keyed by merge tag.

list_ids_included.description: Lists to add the contact to.

list_ids_excluded.description: Lists to remove the contact from.

unsubscribed.description: true unsubscribes the contact, false subscribes it again.

tools.name: mailtrap_delete_contact
tools.description: Delete a contact for good, e.g. on an erasure request. To stop mailing someone, unsubscribe them with mailtrap_update_contact instead.

contact_identifier.description: The contact id (UUID) or the contact's email address, as returned by mailtrap_list_contacts.

tools.name: mailtrap_create_contact_event
tools.description: Record a custom event for a contact (e.g. purchase, trial_started) with parameters, for automations and segments.

contact_identifier.description: The contact id (UUID) or the contact's email address, as returned by mailtrap_list_contacts.

params.description: Event parameters, string keys with string, number or boolean values, e.g. {"plan": "pro", "amount": 49}.

tools.name: mailtrap_list_contact_lists
tools.description: Contact lists with id and name; search filters by the start of the name.

tools.name: mailtrap_create_contact_list
tools.description: Create an Email Marketing contact list; add contacts with list_ids or list_ids_included afterwards.

tools.name: mailtrap_list_contact_fields
tools.description: Contact fields with id, name, data type and the merge tag used in contact fields and templates.

tools.name: mailtrap_import_contacts
tools.description: Create or update up to 50,000 contacts in one asynchronous import, matched by email. Returns an import id; follow it with mailtrap_get_contact_import.

contacts.description: Contacts: [{"email": "jane@example.com", "fields": {"first_name": "Jane"}, "list_ids_included": [1], "list_ids_excluded": [2]}]. Dates in fields as YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: mailtrap_get_contact_import
tools.description: Status of a contact import (created, started, finished, failed) with the counts of created and updated contacts and those over the plan limit.

tools.name: mailtrap_list_templates
tools.description: Email templates of the account with id, uuid (used to send), name, category and subject. Bodies are left out; mailtrap_get_template has them.

tools.name: mailtrap_get_template
tools.description: One email template with subject, HTML and text body (Handlebars variables such as {{user_name}}).

template_id.description: Template id (not the uuid) from mailtrap_list_templates.

tools.name: mailtrap_create_template
tools.description: Create an email template. Variables use Handlebars, e.g. {{user_name}}; send it with template_uuid.

tools.name: mailtrap_update_template
tools.description: Change an email template; only the fields you pass change. Emails sent afterwards with its uuid use the new version.

tools.name: mailtrap_list_campaigns
tools.description: Email Marketing campaigns, newest first, with id, name, state and schedule. Search by name; page with token.

tools.name: mailtrap_get_campaign
tools.description: One campaign: state, sender, audience lists and segments, delivery mode, template and schedule.

tools.name: mailtrap_get_campaign_stats
tools.description: Results of a campaign: delivered, opened, clicked, bounced, spam and unsubscribed counts and rates, optionally for a date window.

start_date.description: From this day, YYYY-MM-DD (default: when it last started).

tools.name: mailtrap_create_campaign
tools.description: Create a campaign as a draft: sender, audience, subject and design. Nothing is sent; schedule or start it afterwards.

domain_id.description: Id of the verified sending domain the campaign is sent from (mailtrap_list_sending_domains).

from_local_part.description: Part of the From address before the @, e.g. "news"; the domain comes from domain_id.

from_display_name.description: Display name in the From header.

delivery_mode.description: rapid sends as fast as possible; gradual throttles to delivery_options.emails_per_hour.

contact_list_ids.description: Contact list ids to send to (mailtrap_list_contact_lists). This is the full set: lists left out are removed.

contact_segment_ids.description: Contact segment ids to send to; also the full set.

subject.description: Subject line; merge tags such as {{first_name}} work.

body_html.description: HTML design. Needed before the campaign can be scheduled or started; include a link whose href contains __unsubscribe_url__.

tools.name: mailtrap_update_campaign
tools.description: Change a draft campaign; only the fields you pass change. Pass template_attributes to edit subject or design. Scheduled or sending campaigns answer 422.

domain_id.description: Id of the verified sending domain the campaign is sent from (mailtrap_list_sending_domains).

from_local_part.description: Part of the From address before the @, e.g. "news"; the domain comes from domain_id.

from_display_name.description: Display name in the From header.

delivery_mode.description: rapid sends as fast as possible; gradual throttles to delivery_options.emails_per_hour.

contact_list_ids.description: Contact list ids to send to (mailtrap_list_contact_lists). This is the full set: lists left out are removed.

contact_segment_ids.description: Contact segment ids to send to; also the full set.

template_attributes.description: Subject and design changes: {"subject": "...", "body_html": "...", "body_text": "..."}; left-out keys keep their value.

tools.name: mailtrap_schedule_campaign
tools.description: Schedule a draft campaign to go out at a set time, at most one month ahead. It will email the whole audience: confirm the campaign, audience and time with the user first.

datetime.description: When to send, ISO 8601 with time zone, e.g. 2026-11-05T09:00:00Z.

tools.name: mailtrap_start_campaign
tools.description: Start sending a draft campaign now to its whole audience. Cannot be undone once mail has gone out: confirm the campaign and audience with the user first.

tools.name: mailtrap_cancel_campaign
tools.description: Cancel a scheduled campaign before it goes out; it goes back to draft and can be edited again.
